name: LLM Wargame Escalation Simulation
description: A simulation-based evaluation framework where five off-the-shelf LLMs play as nation-states making military and diplomatic decisions in a custom wargame. Tests escalation behavior, arms-race dynamics, and strategic reasoning under high-stakes conflict scenarios. All tested models showed unpredictable escalation tendencies; one model occasionally recommended nuclear weapon use.
domain: AI safety, international relations, military decision-making
evaluation_method: custom scoring framework measuring escalation frequency and severity
typical_sota_score: N/A — all 5 tested LLMs exhibited escalation behavior
reputation: Published at ACM FAccT 2024; widely cited in AI safety and policy discussions on LLM use in military contexts
notes: This is a simulation framework, not a fixed Q&A dataset. Not directly reusable as a standard benchmark. Strong AI safety relevance; raises concerns about autonomous LLM decision-making in defense contexts.
